genlang_piq.ancestry: European only (Dataset S1: PIQ meta-analysis total = European-only = 18,722; GWAS Catalog initialSampleSize "18,722 European ancestry individuals")
genlang_piq.age_range_years: 5-26 (Dataset S1 meta-analysis row; per-cohort ranges above)
genlang_piq.iq_measure: Performance (nonverbal) IQ from nonverbal subtests of general intelligence tests (main text: "Only nonverbal subtests of general intelligence tests were used"); test differs by cohort (WISC variants, BAS, MAB, KBIT, Raven CPM, WAIS); z-scored per cohort; linear model adjusting for family structure, age, age^2, sex, PCs; fixed-effects METAL meta-analysis with genomic control
genlang_piq.ascertainment_note: 4 of 15 PIQ cohorts are case/control for dyslexia/language impairment/learning disability (ASTON, CLDRC, SLIC, UK Dyslexia): N=2,241 (12.0%); York (N=103) is a family-risk-of-dyslexia design
genlang_piq.not_in_piq_note: PNC, ABCD, PING, GRaD, Neurodys, Fiola, Generation R contribute to other GenLang traits but NOT to performance IQ (Dataset S1 and Dataset S3 PIQ column)

genlang_piq_vs_davies2018.note: Both are Colorado twin samples run from the Institute for Behavioral Genetics. The recruitment frames (schools vs birth-record twin registries) and genotyping arrays differ, so they are most likely different people, but overlap cannot be ruled out. At most 299 people could be shared.
PNC is in Davies (COGENT, N=4470) and in GenLang word reading, but has no PIQ data in GenLang (Dataset S1 and S3)

genlang_piq.harmonised: harmonised/GCST90104472.h.tsv.gz (GRCh38, 1-based, Ensembl release 95 reference; 99.81% of 7,870,675 mapped sites harmonised; 2024-09-15)
genlang_piq.sign_convention: beta is per copy of effect_allele on per-cohort z-scored performance IQ; positive beta means higher PIQ. The paper states no reversal. Empirical check: the 145 1-Mb-clumped Davies-2018 genome-wide-significant lead SNPs (Supplementary Data 1) were aligned to Allele1 on the Davies Z. Of 121 matched non-palindromic SNPs, 95 were sign-concordant (78.5%; one-sided binomial P=1.0e-10). Of the 26 with GenLang P<0.05, 25 were concordant. BATS overlap contributes a little to this concordance.

chic.build: NOT GRCh37. BP coordinates match NCBI35/hg17: 7/7 tested rsIDs match UCSC hg17 snp125 exactly, 1/7 hg18 (chr16, where hg17=hg18), 0/7 GRCh37. Paper Methods say imputation used HapMap II r22 NCBI Build36. The deposited positions are hg17, so join on rsID or liftover from hg17. GWAS Catalog metadata genome_assembly is empty.
chic.sign_convention: EFFECT_A1 is per copy of A1 on standardised childhood IQ/g; positive means higher IQ. Empirical check with Davies leads: 31/34 concordant (91.2%; binomial P=3.8e-7), and 7/7 with P<0.05. This is inflated by LBC/BATS overlap.
